Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Dandenong South

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Dandenong South. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Dandenong South has a mix of homes, sheds and commercial buildings, and we handle roofs of every size, from a verandah to a warehouse. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Dandenong South: What We Commonly See

Dandenong South is one of the largest industrial and commercial precincts in the country, full of factories, warehouses and showrooms, with pockets of established homes around its edges. The commercial buildings typically carry big flat and pitched metal roofs and long runs of box gutter, while the homes are mostly post-war brick.

Inland and storm-exposed, the wear here comes from heat, UV and the south-east's hail rather than salt. On commercial roofs the issues are rusting and leaking metal sheeting, failed box gutters and worn flashings; on homes it is worn-out roofs, cracked ridge capping and tired guttering. We are set up to handle both.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Dandenong South

From a family home to a warehouse, replacing a worn-out roof properly is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof and re-sheet Dandenong South homes, sheds and commercial buildings in COLORBOND® steel, and we can also build and install flat metal roofing for low-pitch roofs and extensions.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Dandenong South

Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, box gutters, downpipes and ridge capping on homes, sheds and commercial buildings. On larger roofs a failed box gutter or worn flashing can mean serious water damage, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Dandenong South

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Dandenong South Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Dandenong South Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Dandenong South Roofing FAQs

Do you do commercial and industrial roofs?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, warehouses and commercial buildings, and replace box gutters and flashings on larger roofs.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
